article.title: AIP-185: API Versioning
article.abstract: The article introduces AIP-185, which outlines best practices for API versioning. It covers strategies like semantic versioning, backward-compatible changes, and deprecation policies to ensure smooth transitions and compatibility.

newConcepts.definition: Strategies and best practices for managing API versions to ensure compatibility and smooth transitions, such as semantic versioning, backward-compatible changes, and deprecation policies.
Approaches for managing API versions, including semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH), backward-compatible changes, and deprecation policies.
A set of guidelines and best practices for designing APIs, ensuring consistency, clarity, and maintainability in API development.
A widely used language for technical documentation, APIs, and software development.
